messages:
sara: quick FYI — running the quant bakeoff (llama-3-8k) across A100 pools. TensorRT-LLM path is crashing on CUDA 12.3 images, works on CUDA 11.8. Looks like a driver/abi mismatch.

oliver: ugh. can you paste the error? :eyes:

sara: yes — paste below. happens during engine build Stage 2.

```
[TRT] ERROR: ../builder/trt_builder.cpp:456: Plugin creation failed: trt_llm_plugin.so: undefined symbol: _ZN10nvrtcImpl...
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
Aborted (core dumped)
```

oliver: that symbol usually means the runtime's nvrtc was built against a different CUDA. probably CUDA toolkit mismatch in the image vs host driver. what driver version is on the host?

vikram: host driver is 535.86.10 (A100 nodes). In our CUDA 12.3 container we have toolkit 12.3. nvcc reports 12.3. But trt-llm prebuilt binaries expect CUDA 11.x ABI unless built with 12.x.

marta: this matches an earlier note — TensorRT-LLM binary in our image was prebuilt for CUDA11. We need to either: (1) rebuild trt-llm against CUDA12, (2) use a CUDA11-compatible image on those hosts, or (3) fallback to vLLM/Triton path for quant workloads.

kevin: any accuracy differences between trt-llm vs vLLM for AWQ/GPTQ? we should weigh perf win vs complexity.

vikram: quick numbers from the experimental runs:
- AWQ int4 (cpu->trt-llm attempt): failed to build
- GPTQ int4 on vLLM (fp16 runtime): latency ~ 82ms p50, qa EM delta vs fp16 baseline = -2.3% absolute
- AWQ int4 on vLLM: latency ~ 75ms p50, qa EM delta = -3.8% absolute
- TRT-LLM (when we ran earlier on CUDA11): latency ~ 48ms p50, qa EM delta = -2.9%

marta: so TRT-LLM gives ~1.5-2x speedup over vLLM for same quant, but binary compatibility is painful.

oliver: sounds like two separate tracks: get a compatible TRT-LLM build for CUDA12 (eng-runtime) + validate, and short-term enable fallback routing to vLLM/Triton for affected customers.

kevin: can we automate fallback in the serving layer? route by driver check or by container image label?

vikram: we already have smart routing hooks. proposal: detect model variant (quant type) + node capability. If trt-llm build fails at startup, register node as "trt-broken" and avoid scheduling TRT workloads. Also emit alert to #eng-runtime and mark capacity as degraded.

sara: for the immediate bakeoff results — I committed raw logs to s3://redwood-ml/bakeoffs/llama3-8k/1769903456/ (AWQ vs GPTQ vs fp8). Trigger link: https://s3.redwood/llama3-8k/1769903456/summary.csv

marta: action list before we merge any TRT-LLM rollout: 
- rebuild trt-llm against CUDA12 (eng-runtime) — owner: oliver
- run correctness suite (100 sample evals, compare EM/F1) — owner: marta
- add serving fallback + node marker (eng-platform) — owner: vikram
- update Dedicated images docs mentioning supported CUDA/driver combos — owner: sara

oliver: starting rebuild now. estimated ~3h build + smoke tests. I'll push nightly build to our registry with tag `trt-llm:cuda12-compat-176990` when done.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for `trt-llm:cuda12-compat-176990` — build #3421. Logs: https://ci.redwood/build/3421

kevin: one more thing — quantify quality regressions for AWQ vs GPTQ at multiple seeds. AWQ looks slightly worse on EM for qa, but maybe better for instruction-following samples. add a small eval harness for instr-following metrics.

marta: added to correctness suite. will include metrics: EM, F1, RougeL, and Instr-Score (new).

vikram: also check TensorRT kernel fp8 paths vs our fp8 emulation. TRT fp8 kernels require specific driver+CUDA combos; when we enable fp8 quant, we should gate it to nodes that advertise `fp8-rt` capability.

oliver: noted. rebuilding with CUDA12 now. if rebuild passes, I'll run perf perf tests and upload numbers.

sara: perfect. let's keep summary in the bakeoff folder and we can decide rollout plan after CI + correctness. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

marta: assigning follow-ups in Asana: Rebuild TRT-LLM (oliver), Fallback routing (vikram), Correctness + eval (marta), Docs (sara). ETA EOD tomorrow.

kevin: if anyone hits blocking segfaults post-rebuild, ping me and I'll help bisect driver vs nvrtc mismatch.

oliver: done — build started. will post build link when complete.
